action: Google advises using Mandiant’s hardening guide and architectural defense framework against LLM-enabled offensive tooling.
exec: Google says attackers are starting to automate vulnerability discovery and exploitation, and expects more autonomy over time.
plain: Google's threat researchers reported on November 16 that criminal and suspected state-backed hackers are trying out AI tools that find and exploit weaknesses automatically.

key_findings: Several actors, financially motivated and suspected PRC-nexus espionage groups, are experimenting with agentic frameworks including ARTEX, CAIRN, CyberStrikeAI, HexStrike AI and PentAGI.

CAIRN appeared in intrusions against targets including US aerospace; a customised PentAGI platform ran reconnaissance and scanning against organisations in Asia from late August to early October 2026.
For the first time Google saw vulnerability discovery and exploitation fully automated with no human involved, via an exploit_agent framework found on an exposed staging server.
Zero-day exploits averaged 8 a month in 2025 and 11 in 2026, with a spike to 22 in August 2026.
LLMJacking cases handled by Mandiant saw single-day fraudulent charges above $100,000 and cumulative abuse reaching $1 million before remediation; one route was LiteLLM flaw CVE-2026-40217.
recommendations: Use Mandiant's published hardening guide and defence framework for machine-speed, LLM-enabled offensive tooling.
Shorten patch windows, because LLMs are compressing the time from disclosure to working exploit.
Verify LLM-generated proof-of-concept exploits before acting on them; many published ones do not work.

summary: Google’s November 16 threat report says that, for the first time, it found actors using LLM frameworks to automate vulnerability discovery and exploitation with no human in the loop. Code comments are in Russian and server telemetry suggests interest in French media, entertainment and education sites, but Google names no group or state. Other actors are testing agentic tools, and Google expects more autonomy over time.
title: Google warns fully automated AI attacks are arriving
